children: Medical Facilities has sold its controlling stake in Arkansas Surgical Hospital for $63 million.
The company on Monday said it sold its 51% interest in the hospital in North Little Rock, Arkansas, to Surgical Holdings, which is an entity owned in part by its physician partners.
The hospital in 2025 generated $98 million in facility service revenue and income from operations of $19.6 million, representing 39% and 42% of the company's consolidated totals, respectively.
Chair Adina Storch said that the transaction represents an attractive opportunity to unlock value from its assets while supporting broader strategic priorities.
Medical Facilities said it will consider alternatives for the net proceeds, including share buybacks or distributions to shareholders.
